close_reason: Role filtering already implemented in mailbox.rs; added conformance_mailbox_query_filter_role test confirming correct behavior
description: Real JMAP clients (Fastmail samples, jmapc-python) rely on Mailbox/query with filter {role: 'inbox'} or {role: 'drafts', hasAnyRole: true} to find system mailboxes by role. jmapio/jmap-js also uses role-based mailbox lookup. Verify our Mailbox/query handler's filter logic handles the 'role' property. If it doesn't, add role filter support to MemoryMailBackend and document it in MailBackend. Source: jmap-samples-fastmail, jmapc-python/examples/.
title: jmap-mail-server: verify Mailbox/query role filter works
